topNews.headline: Fed Signals Data-Dependent Neutral Rate Calibration Amid Resilient Labor & Term Premium Expansion
topNews.summary: Federal Reserve officials emphasized a calibrated pace of policy normalization, noting that firm labor demand and rising long-end term premiums keep the 10-year Treasury yield anchored near 4.93%.
topNews.macroTakeaway: Upward-sloping yield curve (+30 bps 2Y/10Y spread) reflects term-premium repricing and resilient nominal growth expectations.

topNews.headline: US Treasury 10-Year Yield Holds Near 4.93% Ahead of Quarterly Refunding Auctions
topNews.summary: Benchmark 10-year Treasury notes traded at 4.93% with 30-year bonds at 5.29% as primary dealers absorbed coupon issuance across the belly and long end of the curve.
topNews.macroTakeaway: Positive 2Y/10Y (+30 bps) and 3M/10Y (+80 bps) slope confirms full dis-inversion of the US Treasury curve.

topNews.headline: Gold Surges Past $4,048/oz as Central Bank Reserve Diversification and Inflation Hedging Persist
topNews.summary: Front-month gold futures climbed 2.73% to $4,048.00/oz alongside silver at $51.76/oz, supported by sovereign bullion accumulation and demand for hard-asset duration hedges.
topNews.macroTakeaway: Precious metals outperform despite elevated nominal Treasury yields as investors hedge fiscal supply and commodity inflation.

topNews.headline: Brent Crude Trades Above $101/bbl, WTI at $94.36 Amid Tight Physical Supply Balances
topNews.summary: Global energy benchmarks consolidated gains with Brent crude at $101.72/bbl and WTI at $94.36/bbl following inventory draws and disciplined OPEC+ export allocations.
topNews.macroTakeaway: Elevated energy prices sustain inflation breakevens and create terms-of-trade divergence across emerging Asian economies.

topNews.headline: US Equity Futures Advance Led by Dow Mini (+1.82%) and Russell 2000 (+1.59%)
topNews.summary: Cyclical and industrial shares led US index futures higher with S&P 500 E-mini reaching 7,665.25 (+0.90%) and Dow Jones Mini hitting 52,839.00.
topNews.macroTakeaway: Breadth rotation into industrials, energy, and domestic small-caps offsets rate sensitivity in mega-cap technology.

topNews.headline: Core Services Inflation Moderates Gradually While Commodity Input Costs Re-Accelerate
topNews.summary: Shelter and core services price pressures continued their gradual descent, though higher energy and industrial metal prices ($6.40/lb copper) keep headline CPI vigilance elevated.
topNews.macroTakeaway: Supports Fed pause posture near 4.00% short-end bill rates while keeping long-end inflation expectations firm.

topNews.headline: Euro Climbs to 1.1270 Against US Dollar as ECB Signals Measured Policy Stance
topNews.summary: EUR/USD advanced 0.70% to 1.1270 and GBP/USD rose 0.64% to 1.3495 as European rate differentials stabilized against front-end US Treasury bills.
topNews.macroTakeaway: G10 currency strength contrasts with depreciation pressures in emerging Asian FX facing higher energy import bills.

topNews.headline: USD/JPY Trades at 158.29 as US-Japan Long-End Yield Differential Remains Wide
topNews.summary: The Japanese Yen traded at 158.29 per US dollar as the ~4.93% US 10-year Treasury yield continues to incentivize structural outbound portfolio flows from Tokyo institutions.
topNews.macroTakeaway: Ministry of Finance intervention watch remains active above the 158.00–160.00 threshold.

topNews.headline: Global Copper Futures Hold at $6.40/lb on Grid Electrification and Data Center Demand
topNews.summary: COMEX copper futures gained 0.34% to $6.40/lb as physical warehouse stocks remained tight amid ongoing power-grid expansion and AI infrastructure buildouts.
topNews.macroTakeaway: Supports base-metal exporters while reinforcing structural capex cycle across resource-producing economies.

topNews.headline: Emerging Market Sovereign Spreads Adjust to Higher US Long-End Yields and Oil Above $94
topNews.summary: EM local-currency bond yields repriced higher alongside the 4.93% US 10-year benchmark, prompting central banks in Southeast Asia to prioritize FX stability operations.
topNews.macroTakeaway: High-carry sovereigns utilize short-term central bank bills and triple-intervention tools to anchor domestic bond curves.

commentary.title: Bank Indonesia Macro Commentary & Fixed Income Outlook
commentary.executiveSummary: Bank Indonesia (BI) maintains its benchmark BI-Rate at 5.75% (Deposit Facility at 5.00%, Lending Facility at 6.50%), prioritizing Rupiah stability as USD/IDR trades around 18,155 (JISDOR fixing at Rp 18,148) amid elevated global long-end yields and Brent crude above $101/bbl. Benchmark 10-year IndoGB (SBN) yields trade at 7.71% (+278 bps spread over 10Y US Treasuries at 4.93%), while 5-year IndoGB yields stand at 7.54%. To anchor money-market liquidity and attract foreign portfolio inflows, BI continues active Sekuritas Rupiah Bank Indonesia (SRBI) auctions with weighted-average winning yields at 6.49% (6M), 6.53% (9M), and 6.60% (12M).

macroPillars.heading: Monetary & Liquidity Operations (SRBI & Triple Intervention)
macroPillars.analysis: Bank Indonesia is actively deploying its triple-intervention framework across spot FX, Domestic Non-Deliverable Forwards (DNDF), and secondary-market SBN purchases while awarding SRBI at 6.49%–6.60% across 6M to 12M tenors to maintain attractive carry over US short-end bills.

macroPillars.heading: Sovereign Debt Curve (IndoGB / SBN) & Fiscal Discipline
macroPillars.analysis: The IndoGB curve has repriced tightly in the 7.54% (5Y) to 7.74% (20Y) corridor, offering a +278 bps sovereign spread on the 10-year benchmark (7.71%) over 10Y US Treasuries (4.93%). Domestic institutional demand from onshore banks and pension funds continues to anchor DJPPR primary auctions.

macroPillars.heading: Currency Dynamics (JISDOR / NDF) & Equity Market
macroPillars.analysis: With USD/IDR spot at 18,155 and BI JISDOR at 18,148, offshore 1-Month NDFs trade at 18,198 (+43 IDR / 2.84% annualized basis) and 3-Month NDFs at 18,285. On the Indonesia Stock Exchange, the IDX Composite (IHSG) stabilized at 4,919.77 (+0.32%) following recent risk-off repricing.

commentary.biPolicyPosture: Vigilant FX Stabilization (BI-Rate 5.75% · Triple Intervention Active)

noteworthyHeadlines.title: Bank Indonesia Anchors BI-Rate at 5.75% and Deploys Triple Intervention as JISDOR Fixes at Rp 18,148
noteworthyHeadlines.significance: Coordinates spot FX, DNDF, and secondary SBN market stabilization to contain imported inflation and currency volatility.

noteworthyHeadlines.title: Benchmark 10-Year IndoGB Yield Trades at 7.71%, Maintaining +278 bps Spread Over 10Y US Treasury
noteworthyHeadlines.significance: Flat 10Y–20Y curve (7.71% to 7.74%) reflects resilient onshore institutional duration absorption despite global yield pressure.

noteworthyHeadlines.title: SRBI Auction Yields Clear at 6.49% (6M), 6.53% (9M), and 6.60% (12M) in Latest Open Market Operations
noteworthyHeadlines.significance: Maintains positive short-end carry over 3M–1Y US Treasury bills (4.13%–4.46%) to support foreign portfolio roll-overs.

noteworthyHeadlines.title: IHSG (IDX Composite) Closes at 4,919.77 (+0.32%) as Commodity Exporters Offset Rate-Sensitive Sectors
noteworthyHeadlines.significance: Strength in energy, gold, and base-metal producers cushions domestic equities amid tighter global financial conditions.
